Name: Seed Samples Expanded (Over 20 Languages)
Author: xDuc
Description:
[center][b][color=#ff7700][size=6]Enhance Your Stardew Valley Experience[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[i]As a passionate Stardew Valley player, I wanted to add an extra dimension to this mod by including more seeds and translating the content into many languages so that players worldwide can fully enjoy it. I hope these additions make your gaming experience even more rewarding.
[/i]
[b][color=#ffd966][size=5]SEED SAMPLES EXPANDED (24 Languages)[/size][/color][/b]
This mod adds a personal touch to the game by allowing you to receive various letters from Pierre, in which he will send you seeds by mail. With a total of [b]fourteen letters[/b], [b]twelve of which are repeatable[/b], each season brings its own surprises and agricultural gifts to aid you in your farming journey.
[i]I’m still learning code modification, but I’ll try to find a solution to add seeds from other mods.[/i]
The mod brings all types of seeds from the base game, with fewer seeds for the rarer ones and more for the common ones.
[center][b]
[color=#f1c232][size=5]Required Mods:[/size][/color][/b][color=#f1c232][size=5]
[/size][/color][/center]
[list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url][/b]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url][/b]
[/list][center][color=#f1c232][b][size=5]Features[/size]:[/b]
[/color][/center]
[list]
[*][b][i]14 Letters from Pierre:[/i][/b] Receive seasonal and occasional letters from Pierre, containing seed samples to help you start or improve your farm.
[*][b][i]12 Repeatable Letters:[/i][/b] Some letters can be received multiple times, providing you with a steady supply of seeds throughout the year.
[*][b][i]i18n Compatibility:[/i][/b] This mod is now compatible with the international translation system, allowing for use in multiple languages.
[*][b][i]New Translations:[/i][/b] This mod has been translated into many additional languages, including:
[/list][color=#ffd966][center]
Arabic (العربية), Czech (Čeština), German (Deutsch), English (English), Greek (Ελληνικά), Spanish (Español), French (Français), Hebrew (עברית), Hindi (हिंदी), Hungarian (magyar), Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia), Italian (Italiano), Japanese (日本語), Korean (한국어), Dutch (Nederlands), Polish (Polski), Persian (فارسی), Portuguese (Brazil) (Português (Brésil)), Russian (Русский), Swedish (Svenska), Thai (ไทย), Turkish (Türkçe), Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt), Chinese (Simplified) (中文 (简体)).[/center][/color]
[center][b][color=#f1c232][size=5]Contact Information:[/size][/color][/b][/center]
If you encounter any issues, translation problems, or have suggestions for additional features, please contact me via direct message or post in the comments.

[center][color=#f1c232][b][size=5]Additional Information:[/size][/b]
[/color][/center]
This mod adds various letters from Pierre, in which he will send you seeds in the mail. There are fourteen letters total, and twelve of them are repeatable.
[i][b]EDIT 1.0.5:[/b][/i] Due to the limitations of Mail Framework Mod, repeatable letters can only be received on one day. Check your mail whenever you have a new letter.
This mod is now i18n compatible and includes a Korean translation thanks to Tubereuse!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][color=blue]Check out this Brazilian Portuguese translation of the mod![/color][/url]
